 Buyer's Guide · gift guide · Sleep Give the smart ring that wears like jewelry, in Deep Rose, gold and four more finishes
 AN 
 By Allie Nguyen 
 November 16, 2026 
 · 
 5 min read 
 If you buy something from a link in this article, we may earn a commission. Learn more 
 A smart ring hides the tech inside a band someone can wear with everything, and that’s why the Oura Ring 5 lands so well as a holiday gift. It tracks sleep, activity, stress and recovery from a finger, with no screen at dinner.
 Silver and Black cost $399. The other four finishes cost $499, and each one runs the same titanium build, the same sensors and the same app. Pick by the jewelry, then.
 Oura Ring 5, Deep Rose, Size 8 
Titanium exterior and interior · 6.09mm wide · Size-specific charger included
Price: $499
Where to buy: Buy on Amazon 
 Oura says the Ring 5 is 40% smaller than the Ring 4, and the band is 6.09mm wide, 2.28mm thick and starts at 2 grams depending on size. That smaller build is the gift upgrade, since a thinner band sits easier beside a wedding ring or a stack of everyday bands.
 Six finishes, two prices, one titanium band
 Deep Rose is the new finish, and it shows pink gold in warm light next to a sweater or a dress shirt. Gold is the redesigned finish at the same $499. Silver keeps the classic metal look for $399, while Black drops to the same $399 in a darker band that suits a watch stack. Stealth and Brushed Silver sit at $499 each.
 Brushed Silver hides scuffs best. Every finish uses a high-performance titanium exterior and a titanium interior, so the color changes and the build doesn’t. I’d pick Deep Rose for warm metals and Gold for anyone who stacks rings with yellow jewelry already in the drawer.
 Size it before you wrap it
 Ring 5 sizing differs from other models, and the free sizing kit at checkout settles it. Order the kit early.
 The box holds the ring, a size-specific standard charger and a USB-C cable, so the gift opens ready to set up that night.
 Sleep scores, readiness and more than 50 health metrics
 Red and infrared LEDs measure blood oxygen, while green and infrared LEDs alternate to measure heart rate and heart rate variability around the clock. A temperature sensor and an accelerometer ride inside too. Respiration rate comes from those same LEDs.
 Sleep Score builds on total sleep, heart rate variability, nighttime movement and sleep regularity. Readiness pulls temperature trends, heart rate and sleep into one morning number. Activity detection covers 40 plus activities automatically. Stress gets tracked daily. Readiness tells the morning story in one number, and the scores update as new nights and workouts land in the app.
 Women’s Health and Heart Health sit in the same app, next to cycle insights that use temperature trends across the month. The app runs on iOS and Android phones, with scores, trends and guidance kept in one place. No watch pairing is needed.
 Period prediction and cycle insights use those temperature trends every day.
 Membership costs $5.99 a month after the free month
 A new ring includes the first month of Oura Membership free, and US membership then runs $5.99 a month or $69.99 a year before tax. That fee is part of the gift.
 Monthly billing adds up to $71.88 across 12 paid months, so the annual plan saves $1.89 against paying month by month.
 Membership unlocks personalized insights, an AI health companion and new features as they arrive in the Oura App. Gift the annual plan alongside the ring and the first year feels settled, with no monthly charge landing in January. A $399 Silver ring plus the $69.99 annual plan totals $468.99 before tax. Budget for it upfront.
 Battery, water and the everyday build
 Oura rates one charge at 6 to 9 days of battery life, depending on ring size and usage, and a charge takes about 80 minutes. The separate Charging Case gives a full day of battery in 10 minutes. That case costs $99.
 The ring is waterproof to 100 meters and carries an IP68 rating for water and dust, so showers and swims stay on the schedule. Bluetooth Low Energy handles the sync, and airplane mode is supported for flights.
 Buy it for the right person, skip it for the wrong one
 This gift fits someone who hates charging a watch every night and likes jewelry that stays on a finger all day.
 Oura Ring 5, Silver, Size 8 
Titanium build · IP68 rated for water and dust · USB-C cable in the box
Price: $399
Where to buy: Buy on Amazon 
 Skip it for anyone who refuses subscriptions on principle, since the membership fee keeps running after the free month ends. Skip the size guesswork. The sizing kit exists for exactly that job, and a wrong size turns a sweet gift into an exchange errand during the busiest mail week of the year. HSA and FSA funds can cover the ring and the membership, which helps when the gift budget is really a health budget.
 Buy it if the person on your list wants sleep and recovery tracking in a band that suits a holiday outfit and a gym bag alike. Skip it if a monthly fee will sour the gift by February.
